prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1195; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left quarter panel shows a deep crease with paint transfer along the lower edge, which lines up well with the reported low-speed impact in a parking lot. No prior damage to the vehicle is known, and the pattern of harm appears consistent with this single event. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, repairing and refinishing the quarter panel, and recalibrating the rear sensor. The labor hours on the estimate fit the scope of the work described. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently being checked against the shop's invoice records before payment is released.
